test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only three people sit between A and G. Only two people sit to the left of A. F is not an immediate neighbour of G. F sits second to the right of E. C sits to the immediate right of B. Who sits at the extreme left end of the row?
solution:
**Given:**

 
• Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

**Solution:**

1) Only three people sit between A and G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c06f48a06e66d1d9498a0c3b0084460d43ddddc56f7de33e8eaef44ee42288d.png] 

2) Only two people sit to the left of A. 

 
• Only **case 1 qualify **this condition because In case 2 more than two people are sitting on left of A .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/969ed4a621d101515a318adde71de2740890b0d17a5d2200735c1945bc54a0be.png] 

3) F is not an immediate neighbour of G. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0055377b090a27022f35b51d0fdffb1d6b9509fdbf112f72bf783011b3053918.png] 

4) F sits second to the right of E. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dceeb7faa2254bcea394d3d0ad705951d427c431d57e0cf9b242a9447d7c7a02.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53b6dac240732e6613ad714444d7deaf2dca0d65a75fedaf532a5946fafbe05f.png] 

5) C sits to the immediate right of B.

 
• they can sit only left G.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0d96b5adf9dd35fe7649d814b7623d601f7c839691b5c87b4af307767dbbece.png] 

6) NOW, unoccupied position on leftmost where D can sit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22dea7b4b7cf39b3f3bd3be1170ffde05c5bed3a2979bbd648299ee5296d8c50.png] 

**Hence, 'D' sits at the extreme left end of the row.**
